## 2. Ready-to-paste comment / annotation

a(9)-a(10) computed by an exact self-similar renormalization over the 3-corner boundary state (per corner: matched inside / locally saturated but exposed / unmatched with an unmatched neighbour), composing three copies of SG_{n-1} at each level. The program reproduces every previously published b-file term (a(1)..a(8)) exactly, and each new term was independently verified by two distinct implementations (a second, independently-authored program using a different formulation) that agree digit-for-digit.
